signals.usability_note: Shows the side/gable end of a small stucco house behind a wooden privacy fence, with a large lawn in the foreground; the front facade is not directly visible, so frontage views are limited.
signals.notes: The stucco gable wall shows staining and the wooden privacy fence is weathered and graying; there is an old rooftop TV antenna and a circular gravel patch in the lawn, possibly a well or septic cover, so exterior painting, fence, and siding services may be relevant.
